dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Functional neurological symptom disorder with psychogenic nonepileptic seizures (functional/dissociative attacks), without demonstrable structural, metabolic, toxic, or epileptic cause

ALTERNATIVE 1: Focal epilepsy with hypermotor/versive seizures of unknown etiology

ALTERNATIVE 2: Frontal-lobe epilepsy with a scalp-negative or poorly localizing ictal EEG pattern

ALTERNATIVE 3: Cerebral ischemia or other vascular paroxysmal disorder not excluded because CT angiography was unavailable
